explanation: Ward M/East (Govandi / Mankhurd / Shivaji Nagar) is classified as High vulnerability (HVI 0.742). Primary risk drivers: elevated surface thermal radiance (Mean LST 42.1°C, Peak 45.3°C) and low vegetation (NDVI 0.10); insufficient municipal refuge infrastructure (1 hospitals, 1 parks, 2 water points).
priority_interventions: Deploy cool roofs (high-albedo reflective coatings) across high-density informal settlements.
Urban forestry and roadside green buffers to reduce microclimatic surface skin temperature.
Establish dedicated air-conditioned or passive-ventilated public cooling centres.
Install additional high-capacity public drinking-water refill stations near transport transit points.
